consequences: A real file whose name has many braces is still accepted by the guard and does not block a commit. A comment above the guard's schema says why. Plan item 9.6 assumed the two schemas should match; they serve different inputs.
context: The shared RepoPath caps glob braces (globBraceError), because lock and feature paths are patterns. The guard checks literal changed-file paths from git.
decision: Do not replace the guard's local RepoPath in services/guard.ts with the shared RepoPath from domain/schemas.ts.
title: Guard keeps its own RepoPath schema (review 9.6 rejected)
